Cc: security@acmecorps.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report access for Acme audit window (July 1–15)

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Kestrel Audit will be performing Acme Corps' vendor review July 1–15 and needs access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II artifacts and evidence via your trust portal. We prefer auditor SSO where possible. Can you provide a one-time SSO link or short-lived portal account for our lead auditor (Jordan Blake, jordan.blake@acmecorps.com)?

A few quick details we need to confirm:
- Audit window: Jul 1–15, 2027 (we will likely request a 48-hour download window inside that range)
- Access scope: SOC 2 Type II report, control narratives, and supporting evidence for Jan–Jun 2027 audit period
- Auditor identity: Jordan Blake (lead), sequence of back-up auditors TBD

If SSO isn't possible, a temporary guest account with MFA and a 7-day expiration will work. Please let us know any additional intake steps or paperwork.

Thanks,
Aaron Lee
Audit Ops | Kestrel Audit

Thanks Aaron — happy to help.

Quick answers / ask from our side:
- We can issue a one-time SSO link that ties to Acme's auditor email; the link will require recipient to complete our SAML handshake and will expire after 72 hours unless extended by us.
- For your proposed window (Jul 1–15) we typically provision a 7-day download window centered on the auditor's visit; let us know which 48–72 hour segment they will be using for bulk downloads.
- Please confirm the full list of auditor emails so we can pre-approve them in the portal.

Marissa (CC) will provision the invite and attach our short SSO checklist. For compliance we also need Jordan to sign the standard NDA/acknowledgement (we can push a DocuSign link if required).

Can you confirm Jordan's preferred audit date/time and whether the auditor will be remote or on-site?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference

Jordan: I created a one-time SSO invite that ties to your acmecorps email. Link below expires in 72 hours from first use; please authenticate via your IdP (Acme SAML) and complete the portal acknowledgement. If you need the link to span a specific 48–72 hour download window during Jul 1–15, reply with the preferred start date and time and we will schedule the download window accordingly.

Portal invite (one-time SSO): https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/invite/one-time/xyz-abc-123
Docs attached: Acme_SSO_Requirements.pdf (short checklist), redwood_portal_invite_template.txt (internal invite metadata)

- The invite requires SAML handshake with Acme's IdP; if your SSO admin cannot complete the handshake, we can instead provision a guest account with email+MFA and a 7-day expiry.
- All activity inside the portal is logged; we will provide an access log export upon request.
- We will not enable downloads outside the configured download window. Any extension requests must be made by Acme's security contact (security@acmecorps.com) and approved by our security team.
